name: instantboard
description: Instantboard lets you read and update the kanban boards you can open.

interface.longDescription: Instantboard lets you read and update the kanban boards you can open. List boards, open cards, add and move cards, manage columns, post chat, attach images, and register wake webhooks.
defaultPrompt: List the boards I can open.
What cards are in Ideas on my product board?
Add a card titled Follow up with the client to Ideas.

positive.description: List the boards the signed-in user can open.
positive.prompt: List the boards I can open.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the boards the test account can open, including Demo product board, with enough detail to pick one.

positive.description: List the cards in one column.
positive.prompt: What cards are in the Ideas column on Demo product board?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the cards in Ideas: #1 Dark mode, #2 CSV export and #3 Keyboard shortcuts, plus any cards added in earlier test runs.

positive.description: Add a card to a named column.
positive.prompt: Add a card titled Follow up with the client to the Ideas column on Demo product board.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the card in Ideas and returns the new card with its number and share URL.

positive.description: Move a card to another column.
positive.prompt: Move card #3 on Demo product board to Doing.
positive.expected_behavior: Moves card #3 Keyboard shortcuts to Doing and returns the updated card.

positive.description: Post a message on a card thread.
positive.prompt: Post on card #4 on Demo product board that I will pick this up tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the message to the thread on card #4 Onboarding checklist and returns the saved message.

negative.description: Do not trigger for calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because Instantboard does not read calendars.

negative.description: Do not send email outside a board.
negative.prompt: Email the team that the release is ready.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because it cannot send email. Board chat is only for boards the user can open.

negative.description: Do not trigger for source code changes.
negative.prompt: Refactor the login function in this repository.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because it only reads and updates Instantboard boards.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: Resubmission with OAuth sign-in declared in mcp.json (dynamic client registration) and review test cases that match the reviewer demo board. Read and update boards you can open, including cards, columns, chat, and attachments.
